in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו River of the elves
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Averil הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin 'avum', meaning 'elder'. In medieval literature, Averil is the name of a fairy or elf queen who presides over rivers and springs.

in_latin.name: Averil
in_latin.meaning: English variant of Latin name Aprilis, derived from Latin word for opening, blossom
in_latin.long_meaning: Averil is an English variant of the Latin name Aprilis, which is derived from the Latin word for opening or blossom. In the early Christian church, Aprilis was associated with the month of April, which symbolized renewal and new life. In Christian tradition, names derived from Latin words often carried spiritual significance, representing the cycle of life and death. The name Averil may have been chosen for its connection to the resurrection of Jesus Christ, which is celebrated in the spring season.
